title: A Tradition of Giving Back Through Paint-A-Thon
body_markdown:
## A Tradition of Giving Back Through Paint-A-Thon


Finding ways to give back to the community has been part of Graco’s culture for decades. One of the longest-running examples is the annual Paint-A-Thon.


Since 1985, Graco has partnered with local nonprofit organizations to help homeowners in need while strengthening connections across the company. More than 40 years later, the event remains a highly anticipated volunteer opportunity that continues to make a meaningful impact on both homeowners and employees.


*In 1985 Graco employees participate in Paint-A-Thon and help spray multiple homes.*


#### Helping homeowners stay in their homes longer


Today, Graco partners with Hearts & Hammers, a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping income-eligible seniors, individuals with disabilities, and military veterans or their surviving spouses maintain their homes and continue living independently.


Each year, Hearts & Hammers identifies a homeowner in need and works with Graco to determine the repairs and improvements needed. After the home is selected, Graco volunteers and Hearts & Hammer develop a plan, identify resources and organize volunteer crews.


#### The evolution of Paint-A-Thon


When Graco first became involved with Paint-A-Thon efforts in the mid-1980s, volunteer teams often painted multiple houses each year. Over time, the program has shifted to focus on fewer homes while providing more comprehensive support.


Today, Graco typically completes one house per year, but volunteers often complete a wide range of improvements beyond exterior painting. Depending on the home’s needs, the work may include landscaping, repair, accessibility improvements and any other miscellaneous needs to help homeowners remain in their homes.


This expanded approach allows volunteers to create a more lasting impact for each homeowner.


*Graco employees at Paint-A-Thon 2026.*


#### Carrying on a lasting legacy


For decades, the event was led by Mike Jens, who helped build and sustain Paint-A-Thon as a Graco tradition before retiring in 2021. That same year, Grant Nelson stepped into the role of project manager.


Taking over such a longstanding event came with added responsibility, but it also provided Nelson with a newfound appreciation for the event’s history.


“When I first started helping with Paint-A-Thon, I wasn’t aware of the history and legacy,” Nelson said.


Now in his sixth year leading the event, Nelson has seen enthusiasm for it continue to grow. Volunteer openings often fill quickly, reflecting employees’ desire to give back and connect with one another outside their day-to-day work.


“Helping others and building community is ingrained in Graco’s DNA,” Nelson said. “Graco employees want to do more than just work a job. They want to have a career and build connections.”


According to Nelson, Paint-A-Thon also reflects many of the values that define Graco, bringing together community involvement, teamwork and the opportunity to put Graco products, like its paint sprayers, to work in meaningful ways.


*Paint-A-Thon lead Grant Nelson at a project in 2025.*


#### Expanding impact through volunteerism


Paint-A-Thon is made possible through the support of the Graco Foundation, which provides employees with opportunities to give back through both volunteer service and charitable contributions.


Through the Graco Foundation, employees can participate in volunteer opportunities throughout the year while also supporting charitable causes through donation-matching programs. The Graco Foundation’s support helps ensure events like Paint-A-Thon can continue to create meaningful impact in the community.


For Nelson, one of the most rewarding parts of the experience is seeing employees return year after year to volunteer.


“I think everybody leaves with that sense of purpose and excitement and feeling like they gave back,” he said.


[Learn more](https://www.graco.com/us/en/about-graco/foundation.html) about the Graco Foundation and the opportunities it provides employees.
